, P[M TR P XII COS III P P]

Plated copper alloy copy of Roman denarius prototype from Rome (AD204), of Septimius Severus (AD 193-211), Reece period 10. Reverse is fortuna seated left holding rudder and cornucopiae, legend, P[M TR P XII COS III P P]. Diameter: 18.6mm, Weight: 2.14g
